event.title: Standout released ai agent
event.summary: Standout shipped an ai agent that introduces talent to startup founders acting in full autonomy and it crossed $700k run rate no dashboard and nothing fancy it lives in slack and imessage we launched it a month ago so still very early and and there are a ton of improvements.
